description: This file provides utility functions for user authentication, including sign-up, sign-in, password reset, OAuth sign-in, sign-out, password update, error handling, and fetching current user/session information. It interfaces with the Supabase authentication API and manages URL redirects for authentication flows.

methods.name: signUp
methods.description: Registers a new user with email and password, specifying a redirect URL and optional metadata.

methods.name: signIn
methods.description: Auth login with email and password.

methods.name: resetPassword
methods.description: Sends a password reset email with a fixed redirect URL.

methods.name: signInWithMagicLink
methods.description: Authenticates user via magic link (OTP) with redirect to login page.

methods.name: signInWithOAuth
methods.description: Initiates OAuth authentication with a specified provider, redirecting to a fixed URI.

methods.name: handleAuthError
methods.description: Handles authentication errors, displays toast notifications, and redirects based on error type.
